name: @datacenter-tycoon/cli
description: CLI and TUI client for Datacenter Tycoon.

scripts.test:ci: mkdir -p coverage && c8 --report-dir=coverage --reporter=lcov --reporter=text-summary --all --include='src/**/*.ts' --exclude='src/**/*.test.ts' node --import tsx --test --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=coverage/junit.xml $(find src -type f -name '*.test.ts' | sort)
